snippet.title: Wild Pilot (1992) - (Full Game) Arcade MAME Longplay [153]
snippet.description:
Full Game / playthough / longplay / walkthrough 

Wild Pilot was produced by Jaleco in 1992.

Jaleco released 96 different machines in our database under this trade name, starting in 19.

Other machines made by Jaleco during the time period Wild Pilot was produced include Arm Champs II, Big Striker, Soldam, F1 Grand Prix Star II, Cybattler, 64th Street - A Detective Story, E.D.F. Earth Defense Force, B.O.T.S.S.: Battle of the Solar System, Grand Prix Star, and Avenging Spirit.

A 2-player sitdown, aviation-themed game.
